---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill when building the SplitMate website.
---

1. The website brand is SplitMate.
2. Use the tagline "Split bills, not friendships."
3. Use dark blue (#14213D) and orange (#FCA311).
4. Use Arial for body text and headings.
5. Include a heading, calculator and About section.
6. Display all amounts in PKR.
7. Show amounts with two decimal places.
8. The calculator must divide bills accurately.
9. Make the design responsive for mobile devices.
10. Never display fake customer reviews.
